goals: Verify that the 'find_data' function correctly retrieves data when a matching record exists.
Verify that the 'find_data' function returns None when no matching record is found.
activities: Create a mock Google Sheets client.
Configure the mock client to return a mock sheet object.
Configure the mock sheet to return predefined data records when queried.
Define a search value corresponding to an existing record.
Invoke the 'find_data' function with the mock sheet and the existing search value.
Assert that the 'find_data' function returned a non-null result.
Assert that the 'name' field of the returned result matches the existing search value.
Create a mock Google Sheets client.
Configure the mock client to return a mock sheet object.
Configure the mock sheet to return predefined data records when queried.
Define a search value corresponding to a non-existent record.
Invoke the 'find_data' function with the mock sheet and the non-existent search value.
Assert that the 'find_data' function returned a null result.
